slides.purpose: State the answer and the ask up front
slides.headline: Electronics mix, not volume or freight, cut gross margin by 1.9 pp; a pricing-led plan recovers about 1.4 pp if electronics growth becomes margin-conditional
slides.reason_to_exist: Board reads the answer and the decision in one page

slides.headline: Revenue grew 7.4% while gross margin fell 1.9 pp, leaving gross profit flat at €385M: this is not a volume problem
slides.reason_to_exist: Sales' volume hypothesis is management's prevailing belief and must be explicitly retired

slides.headline: 1.5 of the 1.9 pp decline is mix: electronics, at 11.5% margin, rose from 13.2% to 19.9% of sales; rate erosion explains the other 0.4 pp
slides.reason_to_exist: Core diagnostic: decomposes the decline into its drivers
slides.why_not_merge: S02 retires a wrong hypothesis with revenue/gross-profit data; S03 decomposes the margin bridge — different evidence and exhibit

slides.headline: Freight rose €9M (+23.7%) after the new carrier contract, but it sits in operating costs: an EBIT lever, not a gross-margin one
slides.reason_to_exist: The supply-chain view will be raised in the room; one slide closes it

slides.headline: Electronics is priced 6% below the main competitor; closing the gap at flat volume adds €17.4M gross profit, about +0.9 pp
slides.reason_to_exist: Largest and fastest lever; carries the main risk (elasticity), so it needs its own page

slides.purpose: Show the full plan against the target
slides.headline: Three levers recover about 1.4 pp of the 1.5 pp target by 2027 — repricing 0.9, category rates 0.3, fresh and apparel recovery 0.2 — with no store-labour cut
slides.reason_to_exist: Ties all levers to the board's 1.5 pp target and shows the residual gap
slides.why_not_merge: S05 tests the riskiest single lever; S06 aggregates all levers vs target

slides.headline: The 2026 budget's +25% electronics growth would cut a further 0.7 pp at today's 11.5% margin: growth must be conditional on margin
slides.reason_to_exist: Without this change, the plan is cancelled out by the budget

slides.purpose: State the decision and next steps
slides.headline: Approve the plan with a Q1 2027 electronics price test as the gate, margin-conditional electronics growth and freight renegotiation in the EBIT plan
slides.reason_to_exist: The board needs a clear ask with gates and owners
slides.why_not_merge: S07 quantifies the budget conflict; S08 is the ask with gates and owners across all three key-line points

slides.headline: Category P&L: electronics is the only category growing fast, and at the lowest margin
slides.reason_to_exist: Detailed backup for questions on category numbers

slides.headline: Lever sizing rests on four assumptions to validate, led by flat electronics volume after repricing
slides.reason_to_exist: Shows assumptions and the FY2025 base (actual €1,460M, not the €1,500M forecast)

omitted.why: Small (+€1M each) and below gross margin
Out of scope by constraint; +€2M, below gross margin
